name: The Old Bell, Rembrandtplein
surveyedSource: 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell of BAG pand 0363100012178852 (3DBAG CC BY 4.0, BAG CC0) in native east/south metres (scripts/landmarks/old-bell-rembrandtplein-footprints.json, bag-shell-prepare.ts) for the party walls, rear and inner roofs; the Rembrandtplein front, the corner and the Utrechtsestraat front drawn to the eaves from the rectified Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas recording_2025-06-19_03-28-47_01657 (2025), TMX7316010203-002537_pano_0001_000087 (2022), b_20250120_0926_Track30_Sphere_00341 (2025) and TMX7316010203-000716_pano_0001_000026 (2018), CC BY 4.0.
